categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Adds an IsSymlink filesystem helper in src/util/fs_helpers.cpp to work around MinGW GCC libstdc++ limitations on Windows.
categories.rationale: Fixes broken symlink detection in Windows filesystem utilities where libstdc++ does not support std::filesystem::is_symlink. This resolves a platform-specific gap in common filesystem helpers.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies ListDatabases and GetWalletPath in src/wallet/db.cpp and src/wallet/walletutil.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents ListDatabases from recursively descending into symlink and junction directories on Windows, and prevents GetWalletPath from treating symlinks as regular files. This fixes wallet path resolution and discovery bugs on Windows and re-enables functional tests.
